items.title: Build campaigns that drive high-converting, sales-ready leads.
items.content: In this Ads Decoded episode, we break down data strength: What is it? How can you build it? And why do lead gen campaigns need it?
items.contentSnippet: In this Ads Decoded episode, we break down data strength: What is it? How can you build it? And why do lead gen campaigns need it?

summaries.zh: 本文标题为《构建能带来高转化、销售就绪线索的推广活动》。文章分析了数据力量的概念、构建方法及其对生成线索活动的重要性。通过Ads Decoded节目，内容深入探讨了数据力量的定义、建立方式，以及为何生成线索活动需要它。总结：本文重点介绍了数据力量的定义、构建方法及其在生成线索活动中的作用，强调了其重要性。
summaries.en: This Ads Decoded episode explores data strength in lead generation campaigns. It defines data strength, explains how to build it, and highlights its importance for creating high-converting, sales-ready leads. The discussion focuses on the role of robust data in optimizing lead gen performance.

items.summary: 本文标题为《构建能带来高转化、销售就绪线索的推广活动》。文章分析了数据力量的概念、构建方法及其对生成线索活动的重要性。通过Ads Decoded节目，内容深入探讨了数据力量的定义、建立方式，以及为何生成线索活动需要它。总结：本文重点介绍了数据力量的定义、构建方法及其在生成线索活动中的作用，强调了其重要性。

items.title: Making global data easier to explore

summaries.en: Google and the UN system have launched the UN System Data Commons, an open platform designed to make global statistics more accessible and easier to search. The initiative aims to improve data exploration for researchers, policymakers, and the public by providing a user-friendly interface to access UN data.
